name: Charlotte Foster
source:
A fashion design major at the local college. Charlotte is typically somewhat scatterbrained, kept in check by her best friend, Naomi. She has a tendency to embarrass herself in public, which sometimes deters her from pursuing anyone romantically. Despite sharing a major with fellow student Cassandra, she's often jealous of all the outfits she can afford.
